rationale: Post-earnings flush already happened: TSLA gapped from ~374 to 354.05 and is now BOUNCING (5m score +0.9, RSI 61.7 rising; last bars 359->361), while mid-TF RSI is deeply oversold (30m 15.8, 1h 22.0) and bb_pctb -0.069 sits below the lower band. Shorting here at 360 into a live oversold bounce, just above 354.05 support, is exactly the late-short-into-stretched-tape pattern this book loses on (learned p_win only 0.421) — a squeeze toward VWAP ~367 stops any honest short before the downtrend resumes. Better to let the bounce exhaust into VWAP/broken-support (~367-370) and re-short with 15m/1h trend still down; no clean R:R>=1.5 at 360, so HOLD and arm the trigger.

reconsider.note: Losing 354.05 support breaks the post-earnings base and confirms downside continuation — a clean short with the trend; else a bounce-fade near 367-370 VWAP is the higher-quality short entry.
